note: CHECK config (reduced live probe, offline-prepared 2026-09-25, no live call made). Same frozen data, seed and evaluator as campaign-config.json. Only engines.sequential (iterations, max_evals, max_requests sub-cap) is reduced, for a single sequential 20-iteration wiring/cost check via `python -m integrations.bound_backends live --engine sequential --broker-config broker-config-check.json --campaign-config campaign-config-check.json`.
evaluation: staged: SkyDiscover and sequential score each candidate on the 30-family screen (15 per m, in development.json 'screen'); a candidate valid on the whole screen that ties or beats the best screen score gets a full development evaluation (303 families). GEPA evaluates per family: trainset = development minus screen (273), valset = screen, reflection minibatch 3, so one proposal costs 2*3 + 30 = 36 metric calls. Every call runs the candidate under Seatbelt, 3 s CPU / 5 s wall per family.

sequential.max_evals_note: Halved from the production 50 (screen+full staged evaluation over up to 303 families per candidate, but only failing/changed families need re-certification) for a 20-iteration check.

max_requests_note: CHECK: engines.sequential.max_requests is the requested sub-cap of 25 (the sub-cap requested for this check; the shared pool broker-config-check.json.max_requests is set to 25 to match it explicitly, one below the 24 the config's own contact_ceiling_formula would derive from max_usd 4 -- flagged, not resolved by reducing the sub-cap below what was asked).
order_note: GEPA and the sequential control first at matched iteration counts; AdaEvolve and EvoX only after GEPA shows one productive cycle. EvoX strategy evolution is disabled at every iteration count (it runs generated Python outside the sandbox).
claim_rule: An engine claims progress only if its frozen finalist beats control (b) (integrations/bound_control_sweeplp.py, exact LP over the whole sweep pool) on the holdout; the campaign seed is (b16).
